regime_context: The detector shows a broad, non-directional leadership rotation concentrated in Canadian resource/energy complex: Oil & Gas Producers lead with the only durable trend-eligible 'mixed' Hurst reading, with precious/base metals clustered just behind. Only 8 of 16 themes are trend-eligible (frac 0.5), no one-narrative dominance (absorption 0.3), and telecom/REITs/uranium are deeply ineligible — a split commodity-vs-defensive-defensive tape with no confirmed handoff.
emerging_watch: Watch for a confirmed handoff from Oil & Gas Producers to Gold Miners: if XGD.TO outperforms XEG.TO by 3% over 10 consecutive sessions AND Gold Miners' durability_bar moves above Oil & Gas Producers', the resource leadership is rotating toward precious metals. If instead XEG.TO keeps the top rank through Oct 21 with margin widening, the watch retires.

theses.subject: Oil & Gas Producers
theses.thesis: Top rank with only positive-trend eligibility and highest breadth among leaders (0.429), uncrowded (z 0.85). The absolute-trend gate is the ONE validated leg and it is green here, so a modest overweight respects the discipline; the momentum rank itself is a focus lens, not alpha.
theses.dissent: Hurst 'mixed' means the trend is not clean; energy leadership is exactly the kind of reflexive crowded trade that can reverse hard on a macro surprise (unscheduled_share 1.0 suggests headline-driven tape).

falsifier.text: XEG.TO closes below its 50-day moving average while Gold Miners close above theirs for 5 consecutive sessions before Oct 21

theses.subject: Gold Miners
theses.thesis: Challenger with a narrow margin (0.088) to the leader, eligible and uncrowded (z 0.2). In a high-uncertainty macro backdrop (unscheduled_share 1.0), gold miners offer trend-eligible exposure with mean-revert texture that has not yet broken — a hedging lean rather than a momentum call.
evidence: crowded false, crowding_z 0.2 (least crowded in top 4)
hurst_tag mean-revert, so trend gate is the supporting leg
theses.dissent: Mean-revert Hurst tag means price is not trending cleanly; if the resource complex rotates to oil specifically, gold lags and this overweight is dead weight.

falsifier.text: XGD.TO makes a lower low while the S&P/TSX composite makes a higher high over 10 consecutive sessions before Oct 21

theses.subject: Technology
theses.thesis: Crowded (z 1.17, crowded true) despite mediocre rank 8 and negative score (-0.193). Crowding is a SIZE-DOWN caution only, never a short/fade; but combined with non-leadership momentum, the honest lean is to avoid adding exposure here while the resource complex holds the trend gate.
evidence: rank 8, score -0.193, but eligible true (gate not yet broken)
hurst_tag mixed, breadth 0.7 (broad but not trending)
theses.dissent: Tech has the broadest breadth (0.7) and a mixed Hurst — if the AI/macro narrative (top_headlines include ai_tech) reasserts, this crowded theme could rip higher and an avoid lean costs participation.

falsifier.text: XIT.TO closes above its 20-day high on above-average volume for 3 consecutive sessions before Oct 21

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
